title: Interactive Security & Compliance Triage Assistant for Enterprise Intake
creator: Aria Martinez
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit ad-hoc security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO evidence, GDPR/DPA routing, HIPAA scoping, vendor questionnaires) via email, support tickets, and sales threads. Current intake is manual, inconsistent in triage priority, and requires heavy legal/SE effort to produce evidence or exception language.

Goal: Build an interactive, guided triage assistant (web + API) that: (1) captures structured context through a conversational form; (2) produces a prioritized remediation roadmap and SLA negotiation suggestion; (3) auto-generates a targeted evidence pack assembled from product telemetry and config; (4) recommends contract clause language or pre-approved exception templates; and (5) surfaces a one-click legal sign-off workflow with audit trail. The assistant should reduce manual time-to-response and improve correctness/consistency of tiering for enterprise requests.

Scope: MVP covers intake for SOC2/ISO control evidence requests, DPA & GDPR routing, and vendor questionnaire classification. It integrates with the Console, Support ticketing (Zendesk), and Legal (Okta groups + Confluence storage). LLM components are used only for classification/templating — final outputs require human review before sending.

Out of scope: Full HIPAA intake automation, automated contract execution, and new audit-ready storage beyond Confluence for evidence. Those will be follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: Conversational intake UI embedded in Console with guided prompts for customer, workload, data residency, and requested artifact types
Automated priority score produced (0-100) with rationale and visible signal indicators (sensitivity, contract risk, SLA exposure)
Generated draft evidence pack (zip) that includes links to telemetry snapshots, configuration screenshots, and pre-populated control templates when available
Suggested clause or exception language surfaced with mapping to product controls and required compensating controls
One-click routing to Legal with prefilled summary, attachments, and sign-off checklist; routing creates a Zendesk ticket and Confluence page
Audit log entries created for every step (intake, generation, routing) showing user, timestamp, and decision note
success_metrics: Reduce average first-response time for enterprise security asks from 5 business days to <48 hours
Reduce legal review time for standard evidence packs by 40%
Increase triage accuracy (alignment between system priority and final legal priority) from baseline by 30%
At least 25% of eligible incoming requests are auto-classified and get a usable draft evidence pack in MVP window
